Bind an ExtendedTask status to a shadshiny button

Source: R/task-button.R
bind_shad_task_button.Rd

Experimental. Observes a compatible Shiny shiny::ExtendedTask status function and maps its lifecycle to update_shad_button(). The task remains application-owned; this helper does not invoke the task, inspect its result, or create an async backend.

Usage

bind_shad_task_button(
  task,
  id,
  label_busy = "Processing...",
  label_success = NULL,
  label_error = NULL,
  session = shiny::getDefaultReactiveDomain()
)

Arguments

task

An object with a callable $status() member returning "initial", "running", "success", or "error".

id

Button input id.

label_busy

Label while the task is running.

label_success

Optional label after success.

label_error

Optional label after an error.

session

The Shiny session.

Value

Invisibly, the observer driving the binding.

See also

Other shadshiny server API: shad_message_scroller_to_bottom(), shad_overlay_server, shad_remove_dialog(), shad_show_dialog(), shad_toast(), update_shad, update_shad_command()
